name: Yasaka Yuuki
source:
[url=/c104590]Kanon[/url]'s twin brother, and the only male member of the Yasaka family after their father passed away.

He has been helping with the dormitory work since he was a child. Because he was surrounded by women his whole life, he is used to dealing with them. He can use a little bit of magic, but this must be kept secret since no one outside of the Yasaka family should know that they can use magic.

Due to his strong sense of justice, whenever he sees someone in trouble, he always reaching out to them, even though this is sometimes opposed by [url=/c104594]Hiiragi[/url].

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/nekoking/character/yuki.html]Official website[/url]]

[spoiler]It is revealed later in the story that Yuuki, Kanon, and Hiiragi came from another world. Their father was a hero and their mother was a princess of a certain kingdom. When Yuuki and Kanon were infants, their kingdom was besieged by the demon lord's army, so their parents entrusted them to Hiiragi who is the hero's best friend, and sacrificed themselves in order to sent them to another world, along with the building that is now Minato Dormitory. However, their souls still reside in their children. 

In the end, they are able to go back to their world and defeat the demon lord, but leave Yuuki and Kanon behind in the current world because both of them choose to stay there, and wishing them happiness in their new lives.[/spoiler]
